quirks.condition: Any accepted draw (W) of count sacks, and every turning (T) listing.
quirks.effect: Each open bin carries a hidden keep figure in sacks; deposits credit it 1:1, but a draw debits it by count plus count//6 while the visible total drops by count only, and a turning lists bins by keep (highest first) rather than by the total sacks the spec names.

quirks.condition: Any accepted transfer (M) of count sacks between two bins.
quirks.effect: The source bin's keep loses the full count while the destination bin's keep gains only count minus count//10 sacks; visible totals move by the full count on both sides.

quirks.condition: The end of every turning (T), after listing, shutting, and merging.
quirks.effect: Every still-open bin with a positive keep has its keep reduced by keep//16 sacks; the spec has no such decay.

quirks.condition: During a turning, a listed non-empty bin whose keep satisfies 2*keep < total sacks.
quirks.effect: The bin is merged into the first bin in listed order that is still open, is not itself, does not itself satisfy 2*keep < total, and has free capacity of at least the merging bin's total: a FOLD <bin> <dest> line is printed after the B lines, all sacks and holder roster slots move to the destination (existing holders keep their slot, new ones append), the destination keep rises by the moved total, and the merged bin is closed; with no eligible destination the bin stays open. The spec has no merging.

quirks.condition: An open (O) naming a bin that was previously closed by a turning merge in this session.
quirks.effect: The open is rejected DUP for the rest of the session; a name freed by an ordinary empty shut at a turning may be reopened, as the spec says.

quirks.condition: Two open bins with equal keep at a turning listing.
quirks.effect: The bin with fewer names on its holder roster lists first, and only then does opening order break the tie; the spec breaks equal-fill ties by opening order alone.

quirks.condition: Any accepted draw (W) or transfer (M), and every reckoning (Y) listing.
quirks.effect: Each member carries a hidden measure figure in sacks, credited 1:1 by deposits; a draw debits it by count plus count//4 and a transfer debits it by 1, and a reckoning orders members by measure (highest first, ties by join order) rather than by the sacks currently held that the spec names.

quirks.condition: At a turning, the first-listed bin is exactly at capacity with sacks from at least two members, was also first-listed and exactly at capacity at the previous turning, and both the season just ending and the one before it had at least one accepted deposit and no accepted draw anywhere.
quirks.effect: Every holder of that bin with a positive holding gains measure equal to their own share count, which raises them in later reckonings.

quirks.condition: At a reckoning, a member has three completed seasons of history whose draw sets share at least one common bin, made no deposit and no transfer in any of those three seasons, and still holds a positive amount in such a bin that is still open.
quirks.effect: The member's measure is reduced by 2 times their share count at that reckoning (again at each later reckoning while the condition holds), lowering their reckoning position.

quirks.condition: At a turning, the last-listed bin was also last-listed at the previous turning with an identical listed total, was drawn from at least once between the two turnings, and is still open with a positive total.
quirks.effect: The bin's keep is reset to its total sacks (after the merge and wear steps), which can move it ahead of other bins at the next listing.

quirks.condition: A draw (W) that brings a member's holding in a bin to exactly zero.
quirks.effect: The member keeps their roster slot in that bin, counted in the HELD line and listed by L, and a later deposit resumes the old position; only a transfer (M) that empties the holding removes the slot, after which a re-deposit appends at the back. The spec removes the holder in both cases.

quirks.condition: The end of every reckoning (Y), after the member listing.
quirks.effect: Every open bin's keep moves halfway toward its total sacks, by (total - keep)//2 upward or (keep - total)//2 downward, truncated toward zero.

quirks.condition: Every merge of a bin into another at a turning.
quirks.effect: The Z trailer's transfers field is incremented by 1 for each merge, although no M command was accepted.

unmapped_families.reason: Mixed held-out corpus of long random sessions exercising all rules together; no single quirk maps.
